definition: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model (LLM) developed by American artificial intelligence firm OpenAI.
details: It was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, with general availability coming the following day.

explainer.lead: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model developed by OpenAI. Its launch moved quickly from restricted access to general availability, with only one day between the two stages.

tiers.eli5: Think of GPT-6 Astra as an advanced computer program made by OpenAI that works with language. It was first made available to a selected group of approved users on September 3, 2026, like a preview with a guest list. The next day, it became generally available.
tiers.practitioner: GPT-6 Astra is an OpenAI large language model. Approved users received initial access on September 3, 2026, followed by general availability on September 4. This distinguishes evaluations conducted during the restricted launch from work using the generally available release.
tiers.paperLevel: GPT-6 Astra is a large language model developed by OpenAI. It was initially released to approved users on September 3, 2026, and became generally available on September 4, 2026.

explainer.whyItMatters: GPT-6 Astra is a named OpenAI large language model with a two-stage release: access for approved users first, then general availability one day later.
